source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact tab-separated Greek payload, retaining whitespace and variant markers.

method: Every pinned Greek verse read before authoring. All verses drafted before reading prior Fluent. TSW is a post-authoring comparator, not a wording template. Each authored verse has its own rationale. F0–F3 choices are provisional; no independent review or change quota.

verses.rationale: Retains commanded apostleship and both unusual divine titles.
verses.before: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and Christ Jesus our hope,
verses.after: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus by the command of God our Savior and Christ Jesus our hope,
verses.tsw_comparator: Paul, an apostle of Christ Jesus according to the command of God our Savior and of Christ Jesus our hope,

verses.rationale: Keeps spiritual kinship and the threefold blessing.
verses.before: to Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.after: to Timothy, my true child in faith: Grace, mercy and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.tsw_comparator: To Timothy, my true child in the faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.rationale: Preserves named places, personal commission and unspecified teachers.
verses.before: Just as I urged you when I was leaving for Macedonia, remain in Ephesus so that you may command certain people not to teach different doctrine
verses.after: As I urged you when I was leaving for Macedonia, remain in Ephesus so that you may command certain people not to teach anything different
verses.tsw_comparator: As I urged you when I was going to Macedonia, remain in Ephesus so that you may command certain people not to teach different doctrine,

verses.rationale: Keeps myths/genealogies and contrasts speculation with entrusted order.
verses.before: or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculation rather than God’s stewardship that is by trust.
verses.after: or devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies. These promote speculations rather than God's stewardship, which operates by faith.
verses.tsw_comparator: nor to devote themselves to myths and endless genealogies, which promote speculations rather than the stewardship of God that is by faith.

verses.rationale: Preserves the purpose and all three sources of love.
verses.before: The goal of the command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience, and sincere trust.
verses.after: The goal of this command is love from a pure heart, a good conscience and sincere faith.
verses.tsw_comparator: The goal of this instruction is love from a pure heart and a good conscience and sincere faith.

verses.rationale: Keeps the target-missing and turning images.
verses.before: Some have wandered away from these things and turned aside to empty talk,
verses.after: Some have missed these things and turned aside to empty talk.
verses.tsw_comparator: Some have wandered away from these and turned aside to empty talk,

verses.rationale: Retains their aspiration and double lack of understanding.
verses.before: wanting to be teachers of the Law, though they understand neither what they are saying nor the things they confidently insist on.
verses.after: They want to be teachers of the law, though they understand neither what they say nor what they confidently assert.
verses.tsw_comparator: desiring to be teachers of the law, without understanding either what they are saying or the matters about which they make confident assertions.

verses.rationale: Preserves the wordplay and conditional goodness.
verses.before: But we know that the Law is good if someone uses it lawfully,
verses.after: But we know that the law is good if someone uses it lawfully.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now we know that the law is good, if one uses it lawfully,

verses.rationale: Keeps the paired vice terms and explicit family violence.
verses.before: knowing this: law is not laid down for a righteous person but for the lawless and rebellious, the ungodly and sinners, the unholy and profane, those who strike fathers and mothers, murderers,
verses.after: We know this: law is not laid down for a righteous person, but for the lawless and rebellious, the ungodly and sinners, the unholy and profane, those who kill fathers or mothers, murderers,
verses.tsw_comparator: understanding this, that the law is not laid down for the righteous but for the lawless and disobedient, for the ungodly and sinners, for the unholy and profane, for those who strike their fathers and mothers, for murderers,

verses.rationale: Renders the disputed sexual term with its male referents and names enslavement trafficking directly.
verses.before: sexually immoral people, men who have sex with men, enslavers, liars, perjurers, and whatever else is opposed to sound teaching,
verses.after: the sexually immoral, men who have sex with men, slave traders, liars, perjurers and whatever else opposes sound teaching,
verses.tsw_comparator: for the sexually immoral, for those who practice same-sex relations, for enslavers, liars, perjurers, and whatever else is contrary to sound teaching,

verses.rationale: Keeps glory, blessing and personal stewardship.
verses.before: according to the glorious good news of the blessed God, with which I was entrusted.
verses.after: in accordance with the glorious good news of the blessed God, which was entrusted to me.
verses.tsw_comparator: in accordance with the good news of the glory of the blessed God with which I have been entrusted.

verses.rationale: Retains divine enabling, evaluation and appointment.
verses.before: I thank Christ Jesus our Lord, who strengthened me, because he considered me trustworthy and appointed me to service,
verses.after: I am grateful to Christ Jesus our Lord, who strengthened me, because he considered me faithful and appointed me to service,
verses.tsw_comparator: I give thanks to the one who has strengthened me, Christ Jesus our Lord, because he considered me faithful, appointing me to service,

verses.rationale: Keeps all three prior harms and the stated ground for mercy.
verses.before: though I formerly was a blasphemer, persecutor, and violent man. But I received mercy because I acted ignorantly in unbelief,
verses.after: even though I was formerly a blasphemer, persecutor and violent man. But I received mercy because I acted ignorantly in unbelief,
verses.tsw_comparator: though formerly I was a blasphemer and a persecutor and a violent man. But I received mercy because I acted ignorantly in unbelief,

verses.rationale: Preserves excessive grace and its two companions.
verses.before: and the grace of our Lord overflowed with the trust and love that are in Christ Jesus.
verses.after: and our Lord's grace overflowed with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: and the grace of our Lord overflowed with the faith and love that are in Christ Jesus.

verses.rationale: Keeps the formula, mission and speaker's strong self-assessment.
verses.before: This saying is trustworthy and worthy of full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am foremost.
verses.after: This saying is trustworthy and deserves full acceptance: Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am foremost.
verses.tsw_comparator: The saying is trustworthy and worthy of full acceptance, that Christ Jesus came into the world to save sinners, of whom I am foremost.

verses.rationale: Retains Paul's exemplary place and patience's future audience.
verses.before: But for this reason I received mercy: so that in me, the foremost, Christ Jesus might display all his patience as an example for those who were going to trust in him for eternal life.
verses.after: But I received mercy for this reason: so that in me, the foremost, Christ Jesus might display his complete patience as an example for those who would believe in him for eternal life.
verses.tsw_comparator: But I received mercy for this reason, that in me, as foremost, Jesus Christ might display all his patience as an example for those who would believe in him for eternal life.

verses.rationale: Preserves every title and the doxology's endless reach.
verses.before: Now to the King of the ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.after: Now to the King of the ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.tsw_comparator: To the King of the ages, immortal, invisible, the only God, be honor and glory forever and ever. Amen.

verses.rationale: Keeps personal address, earlier prophecies and military metaphor.
verses.before: Timothy, my child, I entrust this command to you according to the prophecies previously made about you, so that by them you may fight the good fight,
verses.after: I entrust this command to you, my child Timothy, in keeping with the prophecies previously made about you, so that by them you may fight the good fight,
verses.tsw_comparator: This charge I entrust to you, Timothy, my child, in accordance with the prophecies previously made about you, that by them you may wage the good warfare,

verses.rationale: Retains the conscience link and shipwreck image.
verses.before: holding on to trust and a good conscience. Some have rejected these and suffered shipwreck concerning the faith,
verses.after: holding on to faith and a good conscience. Some have rejected these and shipwrecked their faith.
verses.tsw_comparator: holding faith and a good conscience. By rejecting this, some have suffered shipwreck in regard to the faith,

verses.rationale: Names both people and preserves the severe disciplinary claim and corrective purpose.
verses.before: among whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I handed over to Satan so that they may learn not to blaspheme.
verses.after: Among them are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I handed over to Satan so that they might be taught not to blaspheme.
verses.tsw_comparator: among whom are Hymenaeus and Alexander, whom I have handed over to Satan so that they may be taught not to blaspheme.

verses.rationale: Keeps all four prayer terms and universal scope.
verses.before: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings be made for all people,
verses.after: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions and thanksgivings be made for all people—
verses.tsw_comparator: First of all, then, I urge that petitions, prayers, intercessions, and thanksgivings be made for all people,

verses.rationale: Preserves rulers, social purpose and the two qualities of life.
verses.before: for kings and everyone in positions of authority, so that we may live a quiet and peaceful life in all godliness and dignity.
verses.after: for kings and all who are in high positions, so that we may lead a calm and quiet life in all godliness and dignity.
verses.tsw_comparator: for kings and all who are in high positions, so that we may lead a peaceful and quiet life in all godliness and dignity.

verses.rationale: Keeps divine evaluation and Savior title.
verses.before: This is good and acceptable before God our Savior,
verses.after: This is good and acceptable before God our Savior,
verses.tsw_comparator: This is good and acceptable in the sight of God our Savior,

verses.rationale: Retains both universal desire and twofold goal.
verses.before: who wants all people to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.after: who desires all people to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.
verses.tsw_comparator: who desires all people to be saved and to come to the knowledge of the truth.

verses.rationale: Keeps numerical emphasis, mediator role and explicit humanity.
verses.before: For there is one God and one mediator between God and humanity, the human Christ Jesus,
verses.after: For there is one God and one mediator between God and humanity, the human Christ Jesus,
verses.tsw_comparator: For there is one God, and one mediator between God and human beings, the man Christ Jesus,

verses.rationale: Preserves self-gift, universal ransom and temporal witness.
verses.before: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony given at its proper time.
verses.after: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony given at the proper time.
verses.tsw_comparator: who gave himself as a ransom for all, the testimony given at the proper time,

verses.rationale: Retains all three roles, parenthetical oath and gentile scope.
verses.before: For this I was appointed a herald and apostle—I am telling the truth; I am not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in trust and truth.
verses.after: For this testimony I was appointed a herald and apostle—I am telling the truth; I am not lying—a teacher of the nations in faith and truth.
verses.tsw_comparator: for which I was appointed a herald and an apostle—I am telling the truth, I am not lying—a teacher of the Gentiles in faith and truth.

verses.rationale: Keeps male-specific subject, embodied prayer and both prohibited disruptions.
verses.before: Therefore I want the men in every place to pray, lifting holy hands without anger or argument.
verses.after: Therefore, I want the men in every place to pray, lifting holy hands without anger or arguing.
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore I want the men in every place to pray, lifting up holy hands without anger or dispute;

verses.rationale: Preserves female-specific instruction and the complete status display list.
verses.before: Likewise, women should adorn themselves in respectable clothing, with modesty and self-control, not with elaborate hairstyles, gold, pearls, or expensive clothing,
verses.after: Likewise, women should adorn themselves in respectable clothing, with modesty and self-control, not with braided hair and gold or pearls or expensive clothes,
verses.tsw_comparator: likewise also that women should adorn themselves in respectable apparel, with modesty and self-control, not with braided hair and gold or pearls or costly clothing,

verses.rationale: Keeps the contrast between external display and practiced devotion.
verses.before: but with good works, as is fitting for women who profess reverence for God.
verses.after: but with good works, as is fitting for women who profess reverence for God.
verses.tsw_comparator: but with what is fitting for women who profess reverence for God—with good works.

verses.rationale: Retains permission/command to learn and both restrictions.
verses.before: Let a woman learn in quietness with full receptiveness.
verses.after: Let a woman learn quietly with full submission.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let a woman learn in quietness with all submission.

verses.rationale: Preserves the specific woman/man relation while choosing a neutral authority rendering for the rare verb.
verses.before: I am not permitting a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; rather, she is to be in quietness.
verses.after: I do not permit a woman to teach or exercise authority over a man; she is to remain quiet.
verses.tsw_comparator: I do not permit a woman to teach or to exercise authority over a man; rather, she is to remain quiet.

verses.rationale: Keeps names, sequence and creation language.
verses.before: For Adam was formed first, then Eve,
verses.after: For Adam was formed first, then Eve.
verses.tsw_comparator: For Adam was formed first, then Eve;

verses.rationale: Retains the text's gendered contrast and doubled deception wording.
verses.before: and Adam was not deceived, but the woman, being deceived, came into transgression.
verses.after: And Adam was not deceived, but the woman, having been deceived, came into transgression.
verses.tsw_comparator: and Adam was not deceived, but the woman, having been deceived, became a transgressor.

verses.rationale: Keeps the difficult singular-to-plural shift and all four conditions.
verses.before: Yet she will be saved through childbearing, if they remain in trust, love, and holiness with self-control.
verses.after: But she will be saved through childbearing, if they continue in faith, love and holiness with self-control.
verses.tsw_comparator: Yet she will be saved through childbearing—if they continue in faith and love and holiness with self-control.

verses.rationale: Retains aspiration and work rather than importing an institutional title too quickly.
verses.before: This saying is trustworthy: if anyone aspires to oversight, they desire a good work.
verses.after: This saying is trustworthy: If anyone aspires to oversight, that person desires a good work.
verses.tsw_comparator: The saying is trustworthy: if anyone aspires to the office of overseer, he desires a noble work.

verses.rationale: Keeps male marital idiom and the full positive list.
verses.before: Therefore an overseer must be above accusation, faithful to one spouse, sober, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,
verses.after: Therefore, an overseer must be above reproach, a one-woman man, sober, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable and able to teach;
verses.tsw_comparator: Therefore the overseer must be above reproach, the husband of one wife, sober-minded, self-controlled, respectable, hospitable, able to teach,

verses.rationale: Preserves the paired prohibitions and contrasts.
verses.before: not addicted to wine, not violent but gentle, not quarrelsome, not a lover of money,
verses.after: not addicted to wine, not violent, but gentle, peaceable and not loving money;
verses.tsw_comparator: not a drunkard, not violent but gentle, not quarrelsome, not a lover of money.

verses.rationale: Keeps male household headship, children and seriousness.
verses.before: managing their own household well, having children who are respectful and obedient,
verses.after: managing his own household well and keeping his children submissive with complete dignity.
verses.tsw_comparator: He must manage his own household well, with all dignity keeping his children submissive,

verses.rationale: Retains the rhetorical analogy and masculine referent.
verses.before: because if someone does not know how to care for their own household, how will they care for God’s church?
verses.after: For if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how will he care for God's church?
verses.tsw_comparator: for if someone does not know how to manage his own household, how will he care for the church of God?

verses.rationale: Keeps pride's danger and the ambiguous genitive relation to the devil.
verses.before: The overseer must not be a recent convert, so that they do not become conceited and fall into the devil’s judgment.
verses.after: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become conceited and fall into the devil's condemnation.
verses.tsw_comparator: He must not be a recent convert, or he may become puffed up and fall into the judgment of the devil.

verses.rationale: Preserves external testimony and two dangers.
verses.before: They must also have a good reputation with outsiders so that they do not fall into disgrace and the devil’s trap.
verses.after: He must also have a good reputation with outsiders, so that he does not fall into disgrace and the devil's trap.
verses.tsw_comparator: Moreover, he must be well thought of by outsiders, so that he may not fall into disgrace, into the snare of the devil.

verses.rationale: Keeps all four character restrictions.
verses.before: Deacons likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued, not given to much wine, not greedy for dishonest gain,
verses.after: Ministers likewise must be dignified, not double-tongued, not devoted to much wine and not greedy for dishonest gain.
verses.tsw_comparator: Likewise, servants must be dignified, not double-tongued, not indulging in much wine, not greedy for dishonest gain,

verses.rationale: Retains mystery and conscience language.
verses.before: holding the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.
verses.after: They must hold the mystery of the faith with a clean conscience.
verses.tsw_comparator: holding the mystery of the faith with a clear conscience.

verses.rationale: Keeps prior examination and conditional ministry.
verses.before: Let them also be tested first; then let them serve as deacons if they are above accusation.
verses.after: They too must first be tested; then, if they are beyond accusation, let them serve.
verses.tsw_comparator: And let them also be tested first; then let them serve if they prove themselves blameless.

verses.rationale: Preserves women as the stated group without deciding between women ministers and wives.
verses.before: Women likewise must be dignified, not slanderers, sober, faithful in everything.
verses.after: Women likewise must be dignified, not slanderers, sober and faithful in everything.
verses.tsw_comparator: Likewise, women must be dignified, not slanderers, but sober-minded, faithful in all things.

verses.rationale: Keeps the repeated male marital and household qualifications.
verses.before: Deacons must be faithful to one spouse, managing their children and their households well.
verses.after: Let ministers be one-woman men, managing their children and their own households well.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let servants be husbands of one wife, managing their children and their households well.

verses.rationale: Preserves reward, boldness and faith's location.
verses.before: For those who serve well as deacons gain a good standing for themselves and great boldness in the trust that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.after: For those who serve well gain a good standing for themselves and great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.
verses.tsw_comparator: For those who serve well gain a good standing for themselves and great confidence in the faith that is in Christ Jesus.

verses.rationale: Keeps expected personal visit and its timing.
verses.before: I am writing these things to you, hoping to come to you soon.
verses.after: I am writing these things to you, hoping to come to you soon.
verses.tsw_comparator: I am writing these things to you, hoping to come to you soon,

verses.rationale: Retains household/church identification and architectural images.
verses.before: But if I am delayed, I am writing so that you may know how people should conduct themselves in God’s household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
verses.after: But if I am delayed, you will know how people ought to conduct themselves in God's household, which is the church of the living God, the pillar and foundation of the truth.
verses.tsw_comparator: but if I delay, so that you may know how one ought to behave in the household of God, which is the church of the living God, a pillar and foundation of the truth.

verses.rationale: Keeps the pinned relative pronoun and all six balanced lines.
verses.before: And without question, great is the mystery of godliness: He was revealed in flesh, set right in Spirit, seen by angels, proclaimed among the nations, trusted in throughout the world, taken up in glory.
verses.after: And undeniably great is the mystery of godliness: He was revealed in flesh, vindicated in spirit, seen by angels, proclaimed among the nations, believed in the world and taken up in glory.
verses.tsw_comparator: And without controversy, great is the mystery of godliness: He was revealed in the flesh, vindicated in the Spirit, seen by angels, proclaimed among the nations, believed in the world, taken up in glory.

verses.rationale: Preserves Spirit speech, apostasy and two deceptive sources.
verses.before: The Spirit explicitly says that in later times some will depart from the faith, paying attention to deceiving spirits and teachings of demons,
verses.after: Now the Spirit explicitly says that in later times some will abandon the faith and pay attention to deceiving spirits and teachings of demons,
verses.tsw_comparator: Now the Spirit explicitly says that in later times some will depart from the faith, paying attention to deceitful spirits and teachings of demons,

verses.rationale: Keeps human mediation and cauterized-conscience image.
verses.before: through the hypocrisy of liars whose own conscience has been seared,
verses.after: through the hypocrisy of liars whose own consciences have been seared.
verses.tsw_comparator: through the hypocrisy of liars whose consciences are seared,

verses.rationale: Retains both prohibitions and creation's intended grateful use.
verses.before: who forbid marriage and demand abstinence from foods God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who trust and know the truth.
verses.after: They forbid marriage and demand abstinence from foods that God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.
verses.tsw_comparator: who forbid marriage and require abstinence from foods that God created to be received with thanksgiving by those who believe and know the truth.

verses.rationale: Keeps universal creation claim and its condition.
verses.before: For everything God created is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,
verses.after: For everything God created is good, and nothing is to be rejected if received with thanksgiving,
verses.tsw_comparator: For everything created by God is good, and nothing is to be rejected if it is received with thanksgiving,

verses.rationale: Preserves sanctification's two means.
verses.before: because it is made holy through God’s word and prayer.
verses.after: because it is made holy through God's word and prayer.
verses.tsw_comparator: for it is sanctified by the word of God and prayer.

verses.rationale: Keeps communal instruction, minister role and nourishment metaphor.
verses.before: If you place these things before the brothers and sisters, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, nourished by the words of the faith and the good teaching you have followed.
verses.after: By setting these things before the brothers and sisters, you will be a good minister of Christ Jesus, nourished by the words of faith and the good teaching you have followed.
verses.tsw_comparator: If you put these things before the brothers and sisters, you will be a good servant of Christ Jesus, being nourished in the words of the faith and of the good teaching that you have followed.

verses.rationale: Retains the source's gendered insult as ancient rhetoric and the athletic command.
verses.before: Reject godless myths fit for old wives. Instead, train yourself for godliness.
verses.after: Reject profane tales fit for old women, and train yourself in godliness.
verses.tsw_comparator: But reject irreverent myths and old-woman tales; rather train yourself for godliness,

verses.rationale: Keeps limited comparison and both temporal horizons.
verses.before: Physical training is useful for a little, but godliness is useful in every way, because it holds promise for the present life and the life to come.
verses.after: For bodily training is beneficial to a limited extent, but godliness is beneficial in every way, since it holds promise for the present life and the life to come.
verses.tsw_comparator: for bodily training is of some value, but godliness is of value in every way, holding promise for the present life and also for the life to come.

verses.rationale: Retains the recurring formula exactly in sense.
verses.before: This saying is trustworthy and worthy of full acceptance.
verses.after: This saying is trustworthy and deserves full acceptance.
verses.tsw_comparator: The saying is trustworthy and worthy of full acceptance.

verses.rationale: Preserves strenuous work and the difficult all/especially relation.
verses.before: For this reason we labor and struggle, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is Savior of all people, especially of those who trust.
verses.after: For this we labor and struggle, because we have put our hope in the living God, who is Savior of all people, especially of those who believe.
verses.tsw_comparator: For to this end we labor and strive, because we have set our hope on the living God, who is the Savior of all people, especially of those who believe.

verses.rationale: Keeps both authoritative actions terse.
verses.before: Command and teach these things.
verses.after: Command and teach these things.
verses.tsw_comparator: Command and teach these things.

verses.rationale: Retains youth, public example and all five fields.
verses.before: Let no one despise your youth. Instead, become an example for the believers in speech, conduct, love, trust, and purity.
verses.after: Let no one despise your youth. Instead, become an example for the believers in speech, conduct, love, faith and purity.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let no one despise your youth, but set an example for the believers in speech, in conduct, in love, in faith, in purity.

verses.rationale: Makes the public character of reading clear alongside two ministries.
verses.before: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to encouragement, and to teaching.
verses.after: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to encouragement and to teaching.
verses.tsw_comparator: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, to teaching.

verses.rationale: Preserves gift, prophetic mediation and embodied commissioning.
verses.before: Do not neglect the gift in you, which was given to you through prophecy with the laying on of hands by the council of elders.
verses.after: Do not neglect the gift in you, which was given through prophecy with the laying on of the elders' hands.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not neglect the gift that is in you, which was given to you through prophecy with the laying on of the hands of the council of elders.

verses.rationale: Keeps disciplined absorption and public growth.
verses.before: Practice these things; give yourself to them so that your progress may be evident to everyone.
verses.after: Practice these things and immerse yourself in them, so that your progress may be evident to everyone.
verses.tsw_comparator: Practice these things, immerse yourself in them, so that your progress may be evident to all.

verses.rationale: Retains the striking salvation language tied to sustained life and teaching.
verses.before: Pay close attention to yourself and to the teaching. Continue in these things, because by doing so you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
verses.after: Pay close attention to yourself and to the teaching. Persevere in them, for by doing this you will save both yourself and those who hear you.
verses.tsw_comparator: Pay close attention to yourself and to the teaching; continue in these things, for by doing so you will save both yourself and those who hear you.

verses.rationale: Keeps age/gender distinctions and family comparisons.
verses.before: Do not rebuke an older man harshly, but appeal to him as a father, younger men as brothers,
verses.after: Do not rebuke an older man harshly, but appeal to him as a father; treat younger men as brothers,
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not rebuke an older man harshly, but exhort him as a father; younger men as brothers,

verses.rationale: Preserves both female age groups and the purity qualification.
verses.before: older women as mothers, and younger women as sisters, with complete purity.
verses.after: older women as mothers and younger women as sisters, with complete purity.
verses.tsw_comparator: older women as mothers, younger women as sisters, in all purity.

verses.rationale: Keeps the repeated widow term and the text's category distinction.
verses.before: Honor widows who are truly widows.
verses.after: Honor widows who are truly widows.
verses.tsw_comparator: Honor widows who are truly widows.

verses.rationale: Retains family support as religious duty and repayment.
verses.before: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, let them first learn to practice godliness toward their own household and repay their parents and grandparents, because this is acceptable before God.
verses.after: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, let them first learn to practice godliness toward their own household and repay their ancestors, for this is acceptable before God.
verses.tsw_comparator: But if a widow has children or grandchildren, let them first learn to show godliness to their own household and to repay their parents, for this is pleasing in the sight of God.

verses.rationale: Keeps isolation, hope and continual prayer.
verses.before: The woman who is truly a widow and left alone has placed her hope in God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.
verses.after: The woman who is truly a widow and left alone has put her hope in God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day.
verses.tsw_comparator: Now she who is truly a widow, left alone, has set her hope on God and continues in petitions and prayers night and day,

verses.rationale: Preserves the severe living-death contrast.
verses.before: But the one who lives for pleasure is dead even while she lives.
verses.after: But the widow who lives for self-indulgence is dead even while alive.
verses.tsw_comparator: but she who lives for pleasure is dead even while she lives.

verses.rationale: Keeps authoritative instruction and communal goal.
verses.before: Command these things so that they may be above accusation.
verses.after: Command these things as well, so that they may be above reproach.
verses.tsw_comparator: Command these things as well, so that they may be above reproach.

verses.rationale: Retains widening family duty and the strong comparison.
verses.before: But if anyone does not provide for their own, especially members of their household, they have denied the faith and are worse than an unbeliever.
verses.after: But if anyone does not provide for their own, and especially for members of the household, that person has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.
verses.tsw_comparator: But if anyone does not provide for his own, and especially for members of his household, he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever.

verses.rationale: Keeps exact age and female marital idiom.
verses.before: Let a widow be enrolled only if she is at least sixty years old, faithful to one husband,
verses.after: A widow is to be enrolled only if she is at least sixty years old and has been a one-man woman,
verses.tsw_comparator: Let a widow be enrolled if she is not less than sixty years of age, having been the wife of one husband,

verses.rationale: Preserves all five concrete qualifications.
verses.before: well attested for good works: if she raised children, showed hospitality, washed the feet of the holy ones, helped those in distress, and devoted herself to every good work.
verses.after: well attested for good works: if she raised children, welcomed strangers, washed the saints' feet, helped those in distress and devoted herself to every good work.
verses.tsw_comparator: having a testimony of good works: if she has brought up children, shown hospitality, washed the feet of the holy ones, helped the afflicted, devoted herself to every good work.

verses.rationale: Keeps administrative refusal and the text's characterization of desire.
verses.before: But refuse to enroll younger widows, because when their desires draw them away from Christ, they want to marry,
verses.after: But refuse to enroll younger widows, for when their desires draw them away from Christ, they want to marry
verses.tsw_comparator: But refuse younger widows, for when their desires draw them away from Christ, they want to marry,

verses.rationale: Renders faith as pledged commitment in this enrollment context.
verses.before: and so incur judgment because they have abandoned their earlier commitment.
verses.after: and incur judgment because they have set aside their first commitment.
verses.tsw_comparator: thus incurring judgment because they have set aside their former pledge.

verses.rationale: Retains the escalating gendered critique and house-to-house movement.
verses.before: At the same time they learn to be idle, going from house to house—and not only idle but gossips and busybodies, saying things they should not.
verses.after: At the same time, they learn to be idle, going from house to house; and not merely idle, but also gossips and busybodies, saying things they should not.
verses.tsw_comparator: At the same time they learn to be idle, going about from house to house, and not only idle but also gossips and busybodies, saying what they should not.

verses.rationale: Keeps the speaker's specific desire, three household roles and public rationale.
verses.before: Therefore I want younger widows to marry, have children, manage a household, and give the opponent no opportunity for slander.
verses.after: So I want younger women to marry, bear children, manage their households and give the opponent no opportunity for slander.
verses.tsw_comparator: So I desire that younger widows marry, bear children, manage their households, and give the adversary no opportunity for slander.

verses.rationale: Preserves the alarming spiritual judgment.
verses.before: For some have already turned aside after Satan.
verses.after: For some have already turned aside after Satan.
verses.tsw_comparator: For some have already turned aside after Satan.

verses.rationale: Keeps the feminine subject of the pinned reading and allocation of support.
verses.before: If any believing woman has widows in her family, let her help them so the church is not burdened and can help those who are truly widows.
verses.after: If any believing woman has widows in her family, let her help them, so that the church is not burdened and can help those who are truly widows.
verses.tsw_comparator: If any believing woman has widows, let her care for them; let the church not be burdened, so that it may care for those who are truly widows.

verses.rationale: Preserves leadership, doubled honor and teaching labor.
verses.before: Let elders who lead well be considered worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in word and teaching.
verses.after: Let elders who lead well be considered worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in speaking and teaching.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let the elders who rule well be considered worthy of double honor, especially those who labor in preaching and teaching.

verses.rationale: Keeps both quotations, animal image and economic application.
verses.before: For Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it is threshing,” and, “The worker deserves wages.”
verses.after: For Scripture says, “Do not muzzle an ox while it is threshing,” and, “The worker deserves his wages.”
verses.tsw_comparator: For the Scripture says, “You shall not muzzle an ox while it treads out the grain,” and, “The worker is worthy of his wages.”

verses.rationale: Retains evidentiary number and protected office.
verses.before: Do not accept an accusation against an elder unless it is supported by two or three witnesses.
verses.after: Do not accept an accusation against an elder except on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not receive an accusation against an elder except on the basis of two or three witnesses.

verses.rationale: Keeps public correction and its deterrent purpose.
verses.before: Those who persist in sin, rebuke in front of everyone so that the rest may have fear.
verses.after: Rebuke those who persist in sin before everyone, so that the rest may also have fear.
verses.tsw_comparator: Those who persist in sin, rebuke in the presence of all, so that the rest may stand in fear.

verses.rationale: Retains all witnesses and two forms of bias.
verses.before: I solemnly charge you before God, Christ Jesus, and the chosen angels to keep these instructions without prejudgment, doing nothing from partiality.
verses.after: I solemnly charge you before God, Christ Jesus and the chosen angels to observe these things without prejudgment, doing nothing out of partiality.
verses.tsw_comparator: I solemnly charge you in the presence of God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels, to keep these things without prejudice, doing nothing by partiality.

verses.rationale: Keeps caution in appointment, complicity and personal integrity.
verses.before: Do not lay hands on anyone hastily or share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
verses.after: Do not lay hands on anyone hastily or share in the sins of others. Keep yourself pure.
verses.tsw_comparator: Do not be hasty in the laying on of hands, nor share in the sins of others; keep yourself pure.

verses.rationale: Preserves specific medicinal advice and limited quantity.
verses.before: No longer drink only water, but use a little wine because of your stomach and your frequent illnesses.
verses.after: Stop drinking only water, and use a little wine because of your stomach and your frequent illnesses.
verses.tsw_comparator: No longer drink only water, but use a little wine for the sake of your stomach and your frequent illnesses.

verses.rationale: Keeps temporal procession and hidden wrongdoing.
verses.before: The sins of some people are obvious, going ahead of them into judgment, but the sins of others follow later.
verses.after: The sins of some people are obvious, going ahead of them to judgment, but the sins of others follow afterward.
verses.tsw_comparator: The sins of some are evident, going before them to judgment, but those of others follow after.

verses.rationale: Preserves eventual disclosure of good acts.
verses.before: In the same way good works are obvious, and even those that are otherwise cannot remain hidden.
verses.after: In the same way, good works are obvious, and even those that are otherwise cannot remain hidden.
verses.tsw_comparator: Likewise also good works are evident, and even those that are otherwise cannot remain hidden.

verses.rationale: Names slave, yoke and master directly and retains reputation as the rationale.
verses.before: All who are under the yoke as slaves should regard their own masters as worthy of full honor, so that God’s name and the teaching are not slandered.
verses.after: All who are slaves under a yoke must regard their own masters as worthy of full honor, so that God's name and the teaching may not be slandered.
verses.tsw_comparator: Let all who are under the yoke as slaves regard their own masters as worthy of all honor, so that the name of God and the teaching may not be slandered.

verses.rationale: Preserves the coercive hierarchy and the text's intensified service command without calling it harmless.
verses.before: Those who have believing masters must not disrespect them because they are brothers and sisters; rather, they should serve them all the more because those who receive the benefit are believers and beloved. Teach and urge these things.
verses.after: Those who have believing masters must not disrespect them because they are brothers; instead, they must serve as slaves all the more, because those who benefit are believers and beloved. Teach and urge these things.
verses.tsw_comparator: Those who have believing masters must not be disrespectful because they are brothers, but rather serve them all the more, since those who benefit from their good service are believers and beloved.

verses.rationale: Keeps the conditional polemic and health metaphor.
verses.before: If anyone teaches differently and does not agree with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and the teaching that accords with godliness,
verses.after: If anyone teaches something different and does not agree with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and the teaching that accords with godliness,
verses.tsw_comparator: If anyone teaches a different doctrine and does not agree with the sound words of our Lord Jesus Christ and the teaching that accords with godliness,

verses.rationale: Retains disease imagery and the four social effects.
verses.before: that person is conceited, understanding nothing, but has an unhealthy craving for controversies and disputes about words. From these come envy, strife, slander, evil suspicions,
verses.after: that person is conceited and understands nothing, but has a sick craving for controversies and verbal disputes. From these come envy, strife, slander and evil suspicions,
verses.tsw_comparator: he is puffed up with conceit and understands nothing, but has a sick craving for controversies and disputes about words, from which come envy, strife, slander, evil suspicions,

verses.rationale: Keeps mental corruption, lost truth and commercialized religion.
verses.before: and constant friction among people whose minds are corrupted and who have been deprived of the truth, imagining that godliness is a means of financial gain.
verses.after: and constant friction among people corrupted in mind and deprived of the truth, who imagine that godliness is a means of gain.
verses.tsw_comparator: and constant friction among people corrupted in mind and deprived of the truth, imagining that godliness is a means of gain.

verses.rationale: Preserves the rhetorical reversal of gain.
verses.before: But godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.after: Yet godliness with contentment is great gain.
verses.tsw_comparator: But godliness with contentment is great gain.

verses.rationale: Keeps parallel entry and exit.
verses.before: For we brought nothing into the world, and we cannot take anything out.
verses.after: For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of it.
verses.tsw_comparator: For we brought nothing into the world, and we can take nothing out of it.

verses.rationale: Retains basic material needs and sufficiency.
verses.before: But if we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.
verses.after: If we have food and clothing, we will be content with these.
verses.tsw_comparator: But if we have food and clothing, with these we will be content.

verses.rationale: Keeps desire for wealth as subject and the drowning image.
verses.before: Those who want to be rich fall into testing and a trap and into many foolish and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction.
verses.after: But those who want to be rich fall into temptation, a trap and many foolish and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction.
verses.tsw_comparator: But those who want to be rich fall into temptation and a snare and into many foolish and harmful desires that plunge people into ruin and destruction.

verses.rationale: Preserves root, wandering and self-impalement images without calling money itself the root.
verses.before: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evils. By craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many pains.
verses.after: For love of money is a root of all kinds of evil. By craving it, some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many pains.
verses.tsw_comparator: For the love of money is a root of all kinds of evils, and by reaching for it some have wandered away from the faith and pierced themselves with many pains.

verses.rationale: Keeps direct male address and all six pursued qualities.
verses.before: But you, person of God, flee these things. Pursue righteousness, godliness, trust, love, endurance, and gentleness.
verses.after: But you, man of God, flee these things and pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, endurance and gentleness.
verses.tsw_comparator: But you, man of God, flee these things; pursue righteousness, godliness, faith, love, steadfastness, gentleness.

verses.rationale: Retains contest/grasping metaphors and public confession.
verses.before: Fight the good fight of trust. Take hold of eternal life, to which you were called and for which you made the good confession before many witnesses.
verses.after: Fight the good fight of faith. Take hold of eternal life, to which you were called and about which you made the good confession before many witnesses.
verses.tsw_comparator: Fight the good fight of the faith; take hold of the eternal life to which you were called and about which you made the good confession in the presence of many witnesses.

verses.rationale: Keeps both witnesses, universal life-giving and historical name.
verses.before: I charge you before God, who gives life to all things, and Christ Jesus, who testified the good confession before Pontius Pilate,
verses.after: I command you before God, who gives life to all things, and Christ Jesus, who testified the good confession before Pontius Pilate,
verses.tsw_comparator: I charge you in the presence of God, who gives life to all things, and of Christ Jesus, who testified the good confession before Pontius Pilate,

verses.rationale: Preserves moral qualities and future horizon.
verses.before: to keep the command without stain or reproach until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.after: to keep the command unstained and beyond reproach until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,
verses.tsw_comparator: to keep the commandment unstained and free from reproach until the appearing of our Lord Jesus Christ,

verses.rationale: Keeps timing and three rule titles.
verses.before: which the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of kings and Lord of lords, will reveal at the proper time,
verses.after: which he will reveal at the proper time—the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of kings and Lord of lords,
verses.tsw_comparator: which he will display at the proper time—he who is the blessed and only Sovereign, the King of kings and Lord of lords,

verses.rationale: Retains transcendence, human limitation and doxology.
verses.before: the only one who has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no human being has seen or can see. To him be honor and eternal power. Amen.
verses.after: who alone has immortality and dwells in unapproachable light, whom no human has seen or can see. To him be honor and eternal power. Amen.
verses.tsw_comparator: who alone has immortality, dwelling in unapproachable light, whom no one has seen or can see. To him be honor and eternal dominion. Amen.

verses.rationale: Keeps temporal wealth, its instability and divine generosity.
verses.before: Command those who are rich in this present age not to be arrogant or set their hope on uncertain wealth, but on God, who richly provides us everything for enjoyment.
verses.after: Command those who are rich in this present age not to be arrogant or set their hope on uncertain wealth, but on God, who richly provides us with everything for enjoyment.
verses.tsw_comparator: Command those who are rich in the present age not to be arrogant, nor to set their hope on the uncertainty of riches, but on God, who richly provides us with everything for enjoyment.

verses.rationale: Preserves wealth wordplay and both sharing qualities.
verses.before: Tell them to do good, to be rich in good works, generous, and ready to share,
verses.after: Command them to do good, to be rich in good works, generous and ready to share,
verses.tsw_comparator: They are to do good, to be rich in good works, to be generous and ready to share,

verses.rationale: Keeps mixed treasure/foundation/grasping images.
verses.before: storing up for themselves a good foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of the life that is truly life.
verses.after: storing up for themselves a good foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of true life.
verses.tsw_comparator: storing up for themselves a good foundation for the future, so that they may take hold of what is truly life.

verses.rationale: Retains personal appeal, deposit and counterfeit knowledge.
verses.before: Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you, turning away from godless empty talk and contradictions of what is falsely called knowledge,
verses.after: Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you. Turn away from profane empty chatter and contradictions of what is falsely called knowledge.
verses.tsw_comparator: O Timothy, guard what has been entrusted to you, avoiding irreverent empty talk and contradictions of what is falsely called knowledge,

verses.rationale: Keeps target-missing image and plural final blessing.
verses.before: which some have professed and in doing so have missed the mark concerning the faith. Grace be with you.
verses.after: By professing it, some have missed the mark concerning the faith. Grace be with all of you.
verses.tsw_comparator: which some have professed and in so doing have wandered away from the faith. Grace be with you.
